external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The College has been involved in the Erasmus Plus Exchange Programme with Carlsforsska Gymnasiet Upper Secondary school in Vasteras, Sweden for a significant number of years. This exchange programme allows selected learners from certain courses the opportunity to gain work experience in their area of study in Sweden. The courses involved include Hairdressing, Beauty Therapy, Business, Childcare, Pre-Nursing/Healthcare Support and Sport and Recreation. The cost is fully funded by Leargas and feed
